brief:
A committee representing families of political detainees has launched a campaign calling on Palestinians to report cases of arrest and detention across the West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The group is seeking documentation of alleged violations by authorities, including unlawful arrests and summonses issued to residents throughout the territory.

The appeal underscores ongoing concerns among families of detainees over detention practices and the treatment of those held in custody. The committee's push for reporting aims to create a record of alleged abuses and strengthen accountability efforts in the occupied West Bank.
